summary: Iteration 8 — full backend+frontend validation of (1) streamlined Day-1 onboarding and (2) Daily Learning Path retention loop. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_daily_path_and_onboarding.py (~22s) against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Covered day1 first-call-awards-10xp + idempotency + /auth/me flip, daily-path templates (job_interview keys=[chat,writing,grammar], casual fallback for goal=null keys=[chat,vocab,checkin]), task shape (key/title/metric/target/progress/done/to/icon), initial state (tasks_done=0, completed=false, claimed=false, reward_xp=30), baseline snapshot stability across reads, activity-driven progress (POST /api/grammar/check bumps grammar task from 0→1), claim 400 when incomplete, claim +30 XP first call and idempotent second call, and regression on /auth/me /progress /lessons /checkin/today /challenge/today /onboarding/quest /referral/me /vocabulary/daily (POST) /pronunciation/sentence (POST). Frontend: Playwright run on /dashboard /conversation /start-practice with session_token cookie — verified sidebar renders exactly the 7 spec labels (Today/Lessons/Speak with AI/Learn Words/Pronunciation/Improve Writing/Fix My English) plus Premium for non-premium user (AppShell `nav` constant fix confirmed working), DailyPathCard visible with 0/3 ring + three task tiles (daily-path-task-chat/writing/grammar) + correct Start links (/conversation, /writing, /grammar), ContinueLearningBanner correctly appears on /conversation (text 'NEXT UP · 0/3 Submit 1 writing piece Continue') and correctly hidden on /dashboard and /start-practice, /start-practice renders practice-step-1 + practice-progress-bar + step counter ('STEP 1 OF 3') — steps 2/3 are conditionally rendered (only current step in DOM), which matches the component code.

minor.issue: When `goal` is set to an unknown value, it silently falls back to the 'casual' template and stores goal_key='casual' in db.daily_paths — no validation warning. Acceptable, but a log line would help debug mis-set goals.

Claim bypasses validation that today's tasks are STILL satisfied — if state is re-computed between the /claim POST and the $set, it could award under-earned XP. Since state is recomputed immediately before the check on L1262, risk is essentially nil, but there's no unique-index protection against concurrent double-claim (same TOCTOU pattern as /referral/apply flagged in iter7).

Baseline is user_metrics values at 'first call of the day', which means the FIRST call to /api/daily-path must happen before any activity that day — otherwise that morning's activity counts toward baseline and the user effectively needs to do the work twice. Consider snapshotting baseline at midnight (cron) or at day-1 completion to avoid this edge case.

No server-side gate verifying the user actually ran chat+vocab+grammar before marking day1 complete. A client could call /api/onboarding/day1/complete directly from dev-tools and skip the 3-step flow. Low-risk but trust-the-client.

issues: An upgrade-nudge 'You're improving fast' modal auto-opens over the dashboard on load for non-premium users — it obscures the DailyPathCard until dismissed. Consider delaying this modal until after 1st interaction, or showing it only every N sessions.

action_items: Optional: tighten POST /api/onboarding/day1/complete to require the 3 activity metrics (conversation_messages>=1, vocab_words_seen>=1, grammar_checks>=1) so users can't skip the flow via direct API call.

Optional: add unique index on db.daily_paths.(user_id,date) and consider snapshotting baseline at day rollover (not first /daily-path call) to close the 'early-morning activity steals from baseline' edge case.
Optional UX: the upgrade-nudge modal opens on every dashboard visit — throttle it (e.g., once per day or after completing a task) so it doesn't compete with DailyPathCard attention.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at ~1454 lines now — overdue for a router split (auth/profile/lessons/billing/checkin/challenge/onboarding/daily-path/referral). Iter8 added ~110 more lines to the same file.
_daily_path_doc() re-reads the doc on L1218 after insert; cleaner to return the inserted doc directly and skip the extra round-trip.
Both /onboarding/day1/complete and /daily-path/claim use the same '$set + update_streak_and_xp' pattern — extract a small helper to keep idempotency logic consistent across new reward endpoints.

DailyPathCard is purely read-triggered; consider SSE/websocket or an explicit 'mark-complete' after activity-pages navigate back to dashboard to avoid relying on the `window focus` listener for refresh (it won't fire if user navigates in-SPA without tab change).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all spec-required selectors present; banner gating verified on 3 routes)

rca of the issue: No bugs found. All iter8 spec requirements validated. Only latent design/hardening comments listed above — none affect happy-path behaviour.
